title: The world of Jesus & the apostles
authorization: Explicit user instruction authorizes research and implementation of this study, superseding the programme's initial research-only sequence for this item. No public deployment.
teachingSequence: Compare offices and jurisdictions before entering a scene: Galilee, Judaea, Achaia and Philippi.
Village: distinguish archaeology of homes, production and synagogue life from named Gospel events.
Pilgrimage: examine Temple boundaries, synagogue hospitality and contested routes without flattening Jewish differences.
Household: start with Paul's report of unequal meals; distinguish a hypothetical arrangement from his instructions.
City street: compare buying food, accepting an invitation and participating in a cult meal.
Sea journey: change the lens from winds to legal status to cargo and hospitality; retain Acts as the narrative source.
Classify claims as evidence, reconstruction or inference beyond the evidence.

interaction.meaning: Each selection changes the question, highlighted schematic feature, evidence, interpretive limit, citations and linked biblical passage. Scene URLs support history, reload and direct links.
interaction.accessibility: Native buttons with pressed state, visible keyboard focus, live feedback, heading focus after next/previous navigation, reduced-motion CSS and shared site transitions.

visualDesign: Clay and teal field-journal palette, a continuous journey ribbon and large original scene drawings. Site typography, header, page width and transition wrapper retained.
assets: Original SVG schematics only. Not archaeological plans, measured maps or photographic reconstructions. Sea route is selected narrative stops, not a plotted track. No third-party image reuse.
editorial: No Josephus-specific quotations, citations, retellings or dependent arguments in the public study. Institutional records and biblical passages are cited near claims; further reading records access limits.

verification.coverage: All 15 viewpoints, four governments, both quiz outcomes, 37 passage references, source mappings, keyboard Tab/Enter/Space, source disclosure, direct links/back/reload, fixed-header focus clearance, 320/390/768/1024/1440px overflow, light/dark visual inspection, reduced motion, shared transitions and highlighted reader links.
verification.build: Current tree Vite build completed with emptyOutDir:false after a shared asset was locked during the ordinary portable build. Existing preview assets preserved.
verification.typecheck: Study-scoped strict TypeScript check and ESLint. Whole-app TypeScript check has an unrelated ES2020 replaceAll error in StudyBranch.tsx; preserved rather than editing concurrent work.

concurrentWork: An independently added history/WorldOfJesusPage.tsx and its /study/world-of-jesus-and-apostles route were preserved. The Academic category selects this dossier-backed five-scene journey. Other study entries, programme state and release source work were not replaced.
